data.gender_notes: Amnakausar is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Amnakausar is derived from the Arabic words ‘Amn’ which means ‘security, trust, and safety’, and ‘Kausar’ which means ‘generous, noble, and wise’. The name Amnakausar signifies a person who is both trustworthy and wise, someone who can be relied upon for protection and guidance. The name Amnakausar carries the meaning “Noble, Generous, Wise” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Amnakausar usually hope their child will grow to embody noble, generous, wise and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Amnakausar is believed to be blessed by Allah, as it contains the Arabic root letters ‘Nun’, ‘Kaaf’, and ‘Sad’, which are associated with spiritual growth, inner wisdom, and the Divine Presence.
data.etymology: Amnakausar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Noble, Generous, Wise.”

in_arabic.name: مَنكَوُسَار
in_arabic.long_meaning: مَنْكَوُسَارُ: أَصلُهُ مِنْ كَلِمَةٍ مِنْ لُغَةِ عَرَبِيَّةٍ مُتَعَدِّدَةِ الْمَعانِيَّةِ، وَتَشَمَّلُ مَعانِيَ نَبَأَةٍ وَمُغَنٍّ وَمُفَكَّرٍ، وَهِيَ كَلِمَةٌ مُفَرَّقَةُ أَصْلَيْنِ، الْأُولَى مِنْ كَلِمَةِ تَعَلُّمٍ وَتَعَادُدِ، وَالثَانِيَةُ مِنْ كَلِمَةِ مُتَوَهِّدٍ وَمُتَفَكِّكٍ. يَشيرُ إِلى أُنسٍ وَمُتَدَاوَلِ، وَهُوَ أَيٌّ لِأَعَزَّةِ الأَصنامِ، وَكَذَلِكَ لِأَيٍّ لِأَزَلَّةِ الأَصنامِ. وَكُلُّ هَذِهِ الأَيّانِ مُتَوَهِّدَةٌ وَمُتَفَكِّكَةٌ، وَحَيثُ يَصِفُ المُتَفَكِّكُ مِنَ المَعانِيِّ مَخَّافَةً وَخَوَّةً، وَيَصِفُ المُتَوَهِّدُ مِنَ المَعانِيِّ اِستِخَلاصاً وَتَمَكُّناً. وَكَذَلِكَ يَلِيقُ بِهِ أَنْ يَكُونَ المَنكَوُسَارُ مُتَعَلِّقاً بِالوَصايا وَالأَخبارِ، وَخَاصَّةً بِذِكرِ المُصطَفى عَلَيْهِ الْسَلامُ، وَحِصصِ مَخافَتهِ وَمَعانِيهِ.
